english.notes:
(i) This SOW is released pursuant to the Football (Disorder) Act 2000 as incorporated into the Football Spectators Act 1989 which combines domestic and international football banning orders. See also H3440 which remains in force for use for a failure to comply with a reporting condition made pursuant to the Football (Offences and Disorder) Act 1999
(ii) See also H4269 for failing to comply with a notice of a banning order.
(iii) The requirements under section 19(2B) are:
(a) report to a specified police station
(b) surrender passport and, if passport is surrendered additional requirements may be imposed by the imposing authority.
(iv) BE AWARE that if the banning order was imposed in Scotland and breached in England, Wales or Northern Ireland, then a different offence applies.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
